title: 阪神大賞典の後に・刺

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian clutches victory at the Hanshin Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fans are hoping she'll enter the spring Tenno Sho, where she'd face off against Rice Shower, the Sable Assassin…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower is a formidable opponent, strong enough to rival the likes of Mejiro McQueen and Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.text: Narita Brian decides to enter the spring Tenno Sho without hesitation.
